name: Abstinence
overview: Scripture calls believers to live lives marked by purity and self-control, rejecting the works of the flesh such as fornication, adultery, and uncleanness (Galatians 5:19; Colossians 3:5). Abstinence is upheld as part of honoring God's design for marriage, which is to be undefiled and respected (Hebrews 13:4). The example of Joseph resisting temptation (Genesis 39:7) demonstrates the importance of fleeing from sin and maintaining integrity. True beauty and favor come from a reverent fear of the Lord rather than outward appearances (Proverbs 31:30), and Christians are exhorted to walk honestly and decently, avoiding immoral behaviors (Romans 13:13).
